title: lathyrus occidentalis subsp. hispanicus
intro: Lathyrus occidentalis subsp. hispanicus, commonly known as Western sweet pea or Spanish pease, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the pea family (Fabaceae). This plant is rich in various nutrients and bioactive compounds, providing several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus occidentalis subsp. hispanicus include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and act as a natural antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
